parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: This is the wheel of the cart, made of rubber with a metal hub. It is circular and located at the front of the cart.
parts.Functional_description: The wheel allows the cart to roll smoothly and supports the load during movement.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axle to enable forward and backward motion.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the cart, made of steel. It includes the handles, tray, and supporting frame.
parts.Functional_description: It holds and supports the load, providing structure and stability to the cart.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary relative to the wheel, serving as the main load-bearing structure.
